comment: Every balance number in Alpine Resort Simulator. Leaf = {value, min, max, unit, comment}. Curves = {xs, ys, comment}. Code reads by dotted key (e.g. snow.freshDensityKgM3) and never embeds a number. min/max are the real-world anchor range the value was chosen from; the value is designer-editable without recompiling.

resortOpenHour.comment: Lifts open; day mode begins. Typical alpine resort 8:30-9:00.

resortCloseHour.comment: Lifts close; night mode (vehicle operation) begins after sweep.

nightShiftStartHour.comment: Grooming may start once patrol sweep is done.

guestsPerAgent.comment: Cohort size: one simulated agent represents this many guests. 1 = every guest individual. Tests raise it for speed.

aiVehicleTickDivisor.comment: AI-driven vehicles integrate every N ticks with dt*N (LOD). Player vehicle always 1.

mapSizeM.comment: Heightmap edge at 1 m; 2048 = 4.2 km2. Region expansion to 12-20 km2 is M8.

snowCellSizeM.comment: Snow grid cell edge over the skiable envelope.

freshDensityKgM3.comment: Density of the loose layer as tracked; fresh cold snowfall 70-150 kg/m3 (Judson & Doesken 2000).

snowfallDensityKgM3.comment: Density at which snowfall is deposited; converted to loose depth at freshDensity.

compactedLooseDensity.comment: Density of loose snow after one track pass folds it into the pack.

settledLooseDensity.comment: Density of loose snow that settles under its own weight.

settleFracPerHour.comment: Fraction of the loose layer that settles into the pack per hour (fresh snow settles ~50% in a day).

compactionReferenceKpa.comment: Ground pressure that gives full compaction effect; groomer tracks 4-8 kPa.

compactLooseFractionPerPass.comment: Fraction of the loose layer folded into the pack by one full track pass at reference pressure.

compactionTargetDensityByKpa.comment: Packed density a track/tyre pressure drives toward (kPa -> kg/m3). Tracks 4-8 kPa, wheel loaders 60+, trucks 200+.

compactionRatePerPass.comment: How far one pass moves density toward its pressure target.

rutPerVehiclePass.comment: Roughness added by one track/tyre pass on soft snow.

rutSoftDensityLo.comment: Below this density snow ruts fully.

rutSoftDensityRange.comment: Above rutSoftDensityLo + this, snow stops rutting.

corduroyDensityLo.comment: Lower edge of the groomed corduroy density band (measured groomed piste 450-550).

corduroyDensityHi.comment: Upper edge of the band; above it the pack reads as hard/icy.

tillerHardeningRange.comment: Work hardening per pass fades to zero this far above corduroyDensityHi, so ice (700) is an asymptote, not a wall.

tillerTargetDensity.comment: Density a full-width tiller re-lays the pack at (before the compaction bar).

tillerCompactionPerPass.comment: Compaction-bar / work-hardening increment per pass. From fresh snow ~3 passes reach the band; ~9 passes with no new snow push past 600 into ice.

tillerMoistureRetain.comment: Moisture kept after tilling (aeration dries the surface).

roughnessPerSkierPass.comment: Roughness added per skier crossing a cell (x0.4 on hard pack, x1 on soft). ~200 passes on a groomed centre lane build moguls; a busy day puts 150-300 passes on the centre lane.

skierIceRoughnessFactor.comment: Roughness multiplier on icy snow (skiers scrape rather than rut).

scrapeKgPerSkierPass.comment: Snow mass a skier scrapes off a cell per pass on soft snow, moved downhill and to the edge.

scrapeEdgeShare.comment: Share of scraped mass pushed toward the run edge rather than downhill.

scrapeSlopeRefDeg.comment: Slope at which scraping is fully effective.

scrapeMaxFractionPerPass.comment: Never scrape more than this fraction of a cell's mass in one pass.

meltMmPerHourPerDegC.comment: Degree-hour melt factor (snow water equivalent 2-4 mm/day/C ≈ 0.1-0.17 mm/h/C of water; expressed as snow depth of runoff density).

meltRunoffDensity.comment: Density used to convert melt depth into mass removed.

sunMeltMmPerHour.comment: Additional melt on a fully sun-exposed cell under clear sky near 0 C.

sunWarmingC.comment: How much full sun warms the snow surface above air temperature.

rainMeltFactor.comment: Snow depth removed per mm of rain.

windScourFracPerHourAt50kmh.comment: Loose snow lost per hour at 50 km/h wind (scales with wind squared).

moisturePerMeltMm.comment: Moisture gained per mm of melt.

moistureFreezePerHour.comment: Moisture removed per hour by refreezing.

refreezeBelowC.comment: Snow temperature below which wet snow refreezes.

refreezeDensityPerHour.comment: Density gain per hour at full moisture while refreezing.

cellTempRelaxPerHour.comment: How fast a cell's snow temperature follows air + sun.

skierLoosenKgPerPass.comment: Pack chopped into loose granular snow per skier pass; the next tiller pass re-mixes it and pulls density back down, which keeps nightly grooming sustainable.

minCoverageMm.comment: Depth below which a cell counts as not covered (thin cover, rocks show).

densityBandLo.comment: PQI density window low edge (softer than this is slow and ruts).

densityBandHi.comment: PQI density window high edge (harder is icy).

densitySoftLo.comment: Score falls to 0 this far below the band.

densitySoftHi.comment: Score falls to 0 this far above the band (ice at ~700).

bareCapFactor.comment: PQI multiplier at zero coverage (a bare run is never good).

saltMeltMmPerHourPerKgM2.comment: Snow melt on salted pavement per kg/m2 of salt.

saltEffectiveMinC.comment: Rock salt stops working below about -9 C.

saltDecayFracPerHour.comment: Salt lost per hour to traffic and runoff.

plowClearanceMmPerPass.comment: Depth a road plow removes per pass (to within a residual).
